title: Single-cell transcriptomics identifies PRDX1 and GPX4 as potential ferroptosis regulators and tumor microenvironment--related molecules in hepatocellular carcinoma.
snippet: The present study aimed to investigate the expression and roles of peroxiredoxin 1 (PRDX1) and glutathione (GSH) peroxidase 4 (GPX4) in ferroptosis regulation and the tumor microenvironment in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
